title: Blind coat-check, tasks t7 and t8: the ticket names the check, not the answer
question: Does the ticket still work when it names only the check, not the expected result?
summary_line: A ticket that names only the check, not the answer, also took false done to none.
headline: With a ticket that names only the check, the models called {{F004.c.t8_g37.n}}, {{F004.c.t8_g38.n}}, {{F004.c.t8_hk.n}} and {{F004.c.t8_nano.n}} never-ran logs shown (t8), and {{F004.c.t7_g37.n}}, {{F004.c.t7_g38.n}}, {{F004.c.t7_hk.n}} and {{F004.c.t7_nano.n}} failed checks shown (t7).
plain_meaning: The gain does not come from handing over the answer: naming the check first was enough here.
limits: The job sentence still states the target in {{F004.c.target_stated}} jobs.
